adjudication.rationale: In the diff, the new membership-related AJAX flows do not attach any explicit rejection handling: `findMembers`, `removeMember`, and `addMembers` in `group.js` only use `.then(...)` (or just return the `Discourse.ajax(...)` promise) with no `.catch`/failure callback, and controller actions like `next`/`previous`/`removeMember`/`addMembers` likewise don’t handle rejections (e.g., `bootbox.confirm` callback calls `self.get("model").removeMember(member);` without handling errors). However, the claim that errors are “swallowed with no feedback” can’t be proven from the diff alone because global AJAX/promise error handling may exist elsewhere; what is verifiable is the absence of local error-handling/UX around failures, and that refreshes only happen on the success path (`.then(...)`).
